newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary awards two TV channels to CLT, MTM-SBS.
newsitem.headline: Hungary awards two TV channels to CLT, MTM-SBS.

text.p: Hungary's National Television and Radio Board (ORTT) on Monday decided to award the franchises for Hungary's two new commercial TV channels to Swedish-Hungarian consortium MTM-SBS and a consortium led by CLT, which owns Radio et Television de Luxembourg (RTL).
U.S.-based Central European Media Enterprises (CME) failed in both its bids for the two channels, ORTT told Hungarian news agency MTI.
